en.headline: Fourteen fall ill after buffet at Eaton HK restaurant; premises closed for cleaning
en.dek: CHP links five clusters to The Astor at Eaton Hong Kong in Yau Ma Tei; all affected diners are stable and none required hospital admission.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Saturday that five epidemiologically linked food-poisoning clusters involving The Astor restaurant at Eaton Hong Kong in Yau Ma Tei have affected a total of 14 people.

Three additional clusters recorded from Friday to noon on Saturday involve six people who ate buffet meals between 29 and 31 August. They developed vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain and fever 16 to 40 hours later. The two clusters announced on 3 September now total eight affected persons.
None of the 14 required hospitalisation and all are in stable condition. All had dined at the restaurant before control measures were imposed.

Officers from the CHP and the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department conducted an on-site investigation. The Centre for Food Safety directed the restaurant to suspend the implicated food items, clean and disinfect the premises, and train staff. The restaurant has temporarily closed for thorough cleaning and disinfection. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 逸東酒店The Astor食物中毒群組增至十四人 食肆暫時停業
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指五個群組有流行病學關連，受影響人士情況穩定，無人需入院。
body: 衞生防護中心今日表示，油麻地逸東酒店The Astor餐廳涉及的食物中毒個案群組增至五個，累計十四人受影響，全部有流行病學關連。
由昨日至今日中午再錄得三個群組共六人，他們在八月二十九日至三十一日於該店享用自助餐，十六至四十小時後出現嘔吐、腹瀉、噁心、腹痛及發燒。九月三日公布的兩個群組受影響人數亦增至八人。
十四人全部無需入院，目前情況穩定。他們均在當局採取控制措施前到該店用餐。
衞生防護中心聯同食環署人員已到場調查。食物安全中心指示餐廳暫停供應涉事食物、清潔消毒處所並向員工提供培訓。該食肆已暫時停業進行徹底清潔消毒，調查仍在進行。
